voiceSummary: The company has placed before members a special resolution to amend the Articles of Association. This amendment seeks to remove the restriction on the maximum number of directors. The current limit is set at forty directors. The proposed change allows the Board of Directors to determine the number of directors. This determination will be made by the shareholders in a general meeting. The resolution is subject to shareholder approval. It is not yet passed. The company will file the necessary documents with the Registrar of Companies upon approval. This change aligns the Articles with the Companies Act two thousand. The resolution aims to provide flexibility in board composition. Shareholders are requested to vote on this matter. The results of the poll will be announced separately.
